name: secret-guard
description: Hides every secret value in tool output as <hidden:NAME> before the agent reads it, MCP and subagent output included, and writes the real value back when the agent puts the placeholder into a .env or secrets file.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Hide secret values in tool output. Off, the mod does nothing and every value shows as it is.

secretsFile.title: Secrets file
secretsFile.description: KEY=value file whose every value is a secret, whatever its name. A leading ~ is your home folder.

envRoot.title: .env root
envRoot.description: Folder searched for .env files, 5 levels deep, such as the folder that holds your repos. Empty searches none. A leading ~ is your home folder.

minLength.title: Minimum length
minLength.description: Values shorter than this are left alone, except known token formats.

fillCommands.title: Fill placeholders in commands
fillCommands.description: Run a Bash command that names <hidden:NAME> with the real value. Off, such a command does not run, and the agent is told to read the value inside the command.
